column5: prediction markets are a valuable complement to surveys because they are continuous, high-frequency, incentive-compatible, and can reveal a full probability distribution rather than just point forecasts or forecaster disagreement.
column8: Sports prediction contracts appear much closer to gambling than to socially useful derivatives. The evidence on sports betting points to overoptimism, losses, and self-control problems among retail participants, which supports gambling-style consumer protection.
